explication: Apache Pinot is a distributed real-time OLAP datastore for low-latency SQL analytics over streaming and batch data. The primary workflow is a client query entering a broker, being planned and routed to server-side query execution, then returning results; Pinot also supports ingestion, indexing, upsert, administration, and workload controls. The graph combines documented product capabilities with sampled query-planning, server, quota, and workload code. Some cross-service runtime links are shown as dashed and unverified because the relevant dispatch code was not sampled.
